title: הגיימינג מתפצל: רגולציה מחייבת, להיטים גלובליים וקרבות קניין רוחני | Ben's Weekly Digest
summary: Global game launches are now staggered compliance rollouts. Developers must adopt "compliance by design" for monetization, treating it as platform capability, not legal overhead. Commerce infrastructure providers are key to managing fragmentation and achieving "player-first" compliant economies, where compliance becomes invisible to players.
